name: Fiery Blood
body:
School transmutation [fire]; Level druid/shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 4
Components V, S, M (pinch of sulfur)

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one living creature
Duration 2 rounds/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

The blood of the target becomes fiery and burns with a hot, purifying flame. The target glows as brightly as a torch and acquires fast healing 4 for the duration of the spell. In addition, any opponent that successfully strikes the target with a piercing or slashing attack takes 1 hp fire damage for every die of damage inflicted on the target of the spell.

Mythic: The target of the spell gains fire resistance 10.

The fire damage that an opponent takes when it hits the target with a piercing or slashing weapon is increased by a number equal to your mythic tier.
